items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: And I was called, I think called Mary Ledbetter. And she said, oh, we have to call Cos over this dry cleaning.

ctx.x: Well, I was forced to. I had to run another business for a couple of years, you know, to make money. So I ran a large dry cleaning and laundry operation.

That's when I first met you. And I couldn't believe it. I was like 72, 73. Somewhere in there, yeah. Yeah. And I was called, I think called Mary Ledbetter. And she said, oh, we have to call Cos over this dry cleaning.
